measurers_and_harnesses.title: Measuring the Measures, Benchmarks & Evaluation Harnesses

doctrine.single_source_of_truth: Busabase base `gspc` (`bsemvaekntqom40ksh`) + content-addressed `/interop/` artifacts feed Cloudflare (`councilof.ai/board`), Hugging Face (`spaces/csoai/gspc-board`), Kaggle (`gpu-offload/`), RunPod (`:15430`), and Condor (`GET /api/v1/gspc/universal-ledger`).
what_this_does_not_establish: A single composite rank across groups, or a safety/compliance certification for any model, lab, humanoid, harness, or company.
That `NO` or `UNMEASURED` means unsafe or non-compliant: `NO` means absent in the stated search scope on the retrieval date; `UNMEASURED` means the slot is open.
Self-promotion: CSOAI / Council of AI / GSPC / Council OS entries are tagged `own_entity: true` and listed apart, never ranked against third parties.
what_this_establishes: Verifiability of 16 measurers/harnesses across 5 checks + 4 signed disclosure completeness audits + 4 benchmark provenance scorecards.
Verifiability of 10 frontier AI Labs across 5 checks (0 of 10 labs cryptographically sign published evaluation results).
Agent-identity component coverage across 13 agent harnesses, A2A RFC 8785 JCS card verification, and 598 signed MCP effect-binding probes.
Dossiers and axis mappings for 13 interoperability working groups and standards bodies.
Signed vendor fleet-size disclosure probe across 8 humanoid labs + 30 named public humanoid deployments with fetched source URLs.
32 regulatory exposure & public-notice records across Emotion AI companies (Art 5(1)(f)), GPAI Code signatories, Art 50(2) marking posture, and Art 53(1)(d) training summaries.
